opus.problem: The cited verse (Judges 16:29) only says Samson reached for and braced himself against the two central pillars. The pushing and the temple falling come from Judges 16:30. Also, 'it fell' has no clear antecedent: it reads as if one pillar fell, not the temple. Either cite Judges 16:29-30 and say the temple fell, or cut the clue back to the bracing.
